Author: Roxyz0501
Name: Glamour Saver
Description: Adds a SendDiscord button beside the Examine window. Only when pressed, it posts a cropped image, target character name, appearance item names, and Eorzea Database search links to the configured Discord Webhook. The UI supports English and Japanese.
Punchline: Save an examined character's glamour to Discord with one explicit click.
Changelog: Initial public release with English/Japanese UI and one-time first-launch language selection.

Author: Roxyz0501
Name: Character Archive
Description: Stores logged-in character details, jobs, playtime, Lodestone IDs, and configuration-folder mappings locally, then presents them in a searchable UI and CSV export. Optional external lookup and login-time playtime acquisition require explicit settings.
Punchline: Manage characters, jobs, playtime, Lodestone profiles, and configuration folders.
Changelog: Initial public release with English/Japanese UI, localized CSV labels, and bilingual documentation.

Author: Roxyz0501
Name: Aether Current Navigator
Description: Shows field Aether Current and quest progress by expansion and area. It can process the current area or a selected expansion, using vnavmesh for field travel and Questionable for quests. Includes a map view, individual actions, route recalculation, and English/Japanese UI.
Punchline: Visualize and unlock Aether Currents across every expansion.
Changelog: Initial public release with English/Japanese UI, localized game-data names, and persistent language selection.
